# shipd_service_account (Resource)

An organization-level shipd automation identity. Destroy permanently deletes the account and all its tokens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shipd_service_account" "build" {
  name        = "build-automation"
  description = "Identity for the build pipeline"
  enabled     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the service account, unique in the organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the service account.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether tokens can authenticate. Re-enabling restores access for tokens that have not expired or been revoked. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable service account ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns the service account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shipd_service_account.build SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID
```
